name: Miniforge
description: Installs Miniforge for the remote user and optionally initializes conda for the user's shell.

version.description: Miniforge GitHub release tag to install (e.g. '26.3.2-2'). Use 'latest' for the current release.

initShell.description: Shell to initialize with conda init. Use 'auto' to detect the remote user's login shell, or 'none' to skip initialization.
